description: Is this web address a source Fileion knows? Answers known or unknown, and for a known one the kind (official, store, mirror, fileion or vendor) and the title with its Fileion page address. For one of Fileion's own download links it names the file that link serves, where that file comes from, and the "N of 5 checks passed" list. The address is only compared with Fileion's records and is never fetched. Unknown means Fileion has no record of the link; it is not a warning.

url.description: A full http(s) address: host and optional port only, no user name or backslash.

name: check_download_link
title: Check a download link
